bifrost: bifrost_app::attributed, bifrost_app::spellcheck, bifrost_ui::text, bifrost_ui::textfit, bifrost_ui::panels, render font engine
summary: Attributed strings, a rich text editing model, spell checking, a text editing and IME model, line breaking, a font panel and a font renderer exist. There is no multi-line text view widget, no TextKit layout manager and no Writing Tools.

features.feature: Text Display: attributed strings and rich text
features.note: bold, italic, size class, colour token, underline, strikethrough, link only; no paragraph styles, text attachments, lists or tables

features.feature: Text Display: single-line text field and editing model
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/text.rs (TextBuffer, TextEditor, marked text, grapheme movement, undo); docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Text input client'
features.note: editing commands, IME composition and key bindings covered

features.feature: Text Display: multi-line text view widget
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/textview.rs; wired: springboard/apps/voicememos-desktop/src/voicememos.rs (notes card: draw_notes, notes_key, notes_place) on bifrost_app::controls::textview::TextView; sidecar in src/store.rs
features.note: Wave 6 (b14, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. docs/bifrost-ui.md states there is no multi-line text_view widget in the SDK Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (tokenizer, pluggable Dictionary, learned and ignored words); wired: springboard/core/src/spellcheck.rs (model, moved from sdk); springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (SDK re-export); springboard/src/shell/services/text_services.rs (shell service `text`); springboard/sdk/src/text_services.rs (client)
features.note: no system-wide spelling panel or autocorrect UI in text views Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.note: link, date and phone detection only as documented in bifrost-ui.md Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Text Display: line breaking and truncation
features.note: head, middle, tail truncation and wrapping; no tab stops, indents or hyphenation
